log.text: Popovic is inside. His official car will collect him later. The city is already moving.
enforcer heads for d:Boarding pavilion.
the camera pickup notices the enforcer standing still in its sight.
the camera pickup is wary of the enforcer for the rest of the mission.
the camera pickup reports the enforcer loitering (lands 1:38.2).
the camera pickup's report lands: the enforcer loitering. Alert 1.
The desk sends the response (level 2, watchful): 1 robot, 0 units, on the street 1:48.2.
The patrol leaves its sweep for the alarm.
patrol notices the enforcer standing still in its sight.
A rival car turns in off Orbit Walk. It is after Popovic too, and it is coming for our car.
The patrol goes back to its sweep.
The rival car stops across our way out: our car is boxed in.
patrol is wary of the enforcer for the rest of the mission.
rival-1 takes his post round our car.
rival-2 takes his post round our car.
The patrol is back on its sweep.
rival-3 takes his post round our car.
A rival lookout takes up a post watching Popovic's car. If it goes round, he follows it.
Popovic steps out of the official entrance and walks to his car.
enforcer fires on councillor until down.
alert-2: Inez Nikolaou walks back to her post and stays there.
The pickup camera shows the enforcer's weapon drawn. Alert 2.
The watchers on the camera report a drawn weapon. Security is coming from the north street.
